cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: Duplicate of the Novexa DCT 402 label-comparison concept for Motilli Celery Juice Fiber Gummies. One angle: turn the box around and read WHERE each thing you have tried actually works. Three swappable Hook+Bridge pairs (all 0:00-0:08 / 0:08-0:19) hand off to one shared body. Mechanism taught once at 0:30 (GLP-1 slows the stomach, everything downstream backs up). Real named competitor trade dress on screen, read not defaced. Product withheld until 1:18. Runtime 1:48, 333 spoken words. Offer verified live 2026-08-26: Buy 2 Get 1 Free, 90-day money-back, counts on an opened bottle.

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: APPROVAL GATE
cards.text: Approve these beats here before any keyframe or render work starts.

cards.title: NEEDED FROM BROOKS
cards.text:
1. The AI presenter: reuse an existing Motilli avatar or generate a new one. She must never claim to be a customer or report a personal result.
2. Confirm we are happy showing real Miralax / Dulcolax trade dress on Meta. This deliberately inverts the reference, which blurred every competitor label.

cards.title: HARD: product hidden until 1:18
cards.text: The product does not appear in any form before 1:18. Not the bottle, not a gummy, not a corner of the label.

cards.title: HARD: no authority, no numbers
cards.text: No doctor, nurse, clinic, white coat, stethoscope, or medical office anywhere. No on-screen study card, percentage, review count, or patient number. The PDP's 9,400+ / 91% / 4.8-of-9,481 stats are unverified and are BANNED from this ad.

cards.title: HARD: mechanism scope
cards.text: The canonical mechanism's pillars 2 and 3 (digestive enzyme, gut lining) have NO confirmed ingredient on the label. This ad builds its checklist on WHERE / WHAT IS IN IT / HOW YOU TAKE IT instead. Do not reintroduce enzyme or lining claims.

cards.title: HARD: competitor treatment
cards.text: Real named products, labels legible, printed directions line held on screen. Never deface, blur, cross out, or red-X any competitor product. The claim is LOCATION only, never unsafe or habit-forming.

cards.title: Cut rhythm
cards.text: New B-roll every 2 to 4 seconds through the reading sequence. Simple hard cuts, no transitions.
